results.title: Data Analytics Course In Pitampura With 100% Placement - Gyansetu
results.content: Get mastery in Advanced Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI and AI tools to boost career based on data with 100% placement support. The Data Analytics Course in Pitampura by Gyansetu grants an industry-recognized Data Analytics Certification on successful completion certifying the knowledge of Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI and Tableau. Based on Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau and Generative AI, it is organized into 6 months of progressive skills development with weekly projects.​ It is a keyword-based pathway and focuses on practice, beginning with data cleaning in Advanced Excel to SQL querying to Python scripting and AI-driven insights, making it ready to work in the high-demand positions in Delhi without redundancy with the prior sections. During the course you’ll learn all in-demand tools like Advanced Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, and Generative AI through hands-on projects, focusing on real Pitampura industry datasets.​. Many online courses designed specifically to train novices do not require prior programming experience – making data analysis one of the more accessible IT careers to start off in!
